subject: Next steps: Pilot scope, success metrics, and prompt-eval plan — Trailhead AI
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Leah Morgan <leah@trailhead.ai>, Amit Desai <amit@trailhead.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Pilot scope, success metrics, and prompt-eval plan — Trailhead AI

Thanks again for the conversation today — great to hear about the concrete retrieval and classification pain you're seeing on customer support transcripts. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Pain / goals (what we heard)
- Support team: high false positives from intent classifier when transcripts include multi-topic conversations.
- Need: reduce misrouted tickets and improve top-1 intent accuracy to cut manual triage by ~30%.
- Non-functional: low latency required for near-real-time triage (target P95 < 300ms).

2) Proposed pilot scope (30 days)
- Dataset: 10k anonymized transcripts (you confirmed export will be ready Oct 10).
- Workloads: inference for intent classification and confidence-scored reroute suggestions (~5 req/s initially).
- Success metrics: intent accuracy delta, triage F1 change, end-to-end latency P95.

3) Prompt-eval plan
- We'll run a small prompt-eval suite (20 representative prompts + edge cases) to detect regressions early. I attached a starter prompt-eval-template.csv and a POC scope workbook to capture owners and access.

4) Access & next technical steps
- Request list: S3 export link or secure upload, service account with read-only access to the bucket, and a scoped API key for Redwood Private (if you want to run on your VPC) or we can use hosted endpoints.
- Security items: we discussed SOC2 and VPC options — Marissa will follow up with the compliance checklist.

5) Owners & timeline
- Trailhead: Leah (primary PM), Amit (data lead).
- Redwood: Jonas (sales/ops), Marissa (technical lead).
- Tentative timeline: data handoff by Oct 10, initial model run Oct 12–14, prompt-eval + triage metric report by Oct 21.

6) Asks for this week
- Leah: confirm data handoff date and whether transcripts will be PII-scrubbed.
- Amit: share a short sample export (200 transcripts) so Marissa can validate ingestion mapping.

I'll open a HubSpot activity and share the Drive folder where we'll centralize artifacts. If that timeline looks off, say so and we'll adjust.

Best,

Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: Trailhead_POC_Scope_v1.xlsx (workbook: owners, data inventory, success metrics), prompt-eval-template.csv (starter prompts + labels)

From: Leah Morgan <leah@trailhead.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Desai <amit@trailhead.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Pilot scope, success metrics, and prompt-eval plan — Trailhead AI

Thanks Jonas — this is helpful and matches what we discussed. Quick answers: 

- Data handoff: Oct 11 (we had to push one day; engineering wants to run the PII scrub first).
- Sample export: Amit will drop 200 transcripts in the shared folder by EOD today.
- PII scrub: yes — names and emails are redacted, but we keep timestamps and agent labels. If Redwood needs raw identifiers for anything, we can discuss a signed NDA.

A couple of clarifying Qs before we kick off:
1) For the prompt-eval, do you recommend we include a 10% random sample of long-form transcripts (>500 tokens)?
2) Can you confirm what the expected cost footprint looks like at our projected 5 req/s over 30 days (ballpark)?

Appreciate Marissa joining the thread — she can coordinate the S3 permissions.

Cheers,
Leah
Product Lead | Trailhead AI
leah@trailhead.ai

---
On Mon, 4 Oct 2027 at 08:02, Amit Desai <amit@trailhead.ai> wrote:
> Dropping the first sample now. It's in the Drive folder (sample_transcripts_200.jsonl).
> —Amit

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Leah Morgan <leah@trailhead.ai>, Amit Desai <amit@trailhead.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Pilot scope, success metrics, and prompt-eval plan — Trailhead AI

Perfect — thanks for the updates and the sample, Amit. Short answers and next actions: 

1) Long-form transcripts: yes, include ~10–15% long-form samples (they expose tokenization edge cases). We'll flag them in the eval suite.

2) Ballpark cost at 5 req/s (hosted): ~ $2.5k–$4k over 30 days depending on model variant; if you want a Dedicated pool or Private deployment that changes the economics — we can run a cost model once we see real throughput. I'll attach a simple delta table to the HubSpot deal.

3) Marissa will lead the ingestion validation. Marissa — when you have the sample, can you confirm schema mapping and whether we need a custom parser for agent labels?

Next milestones (updated):
- Oct 5: ingest sample validation (Marissa)
- Oct 11: full data handoff (Trailhead)
- Oct 12–15: initial runs + prompt-eval
- Oct 21: metric report and recommendations

I'll create a shared Slack channel and a Sprint Trello board for the 30-day window; adding Marissa to the workspace invite now. If anything changes on your side, tell me and we'll re-lock dates.

Thanks — look forward to getting started.

Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: Trailhead_POC_Scope_v1.xlsx, prompt-eval-template.csv
